fact: Gannet gateways use the western keeper and expire after nineteen minutes.
handoff_case: actual native task handoff at control/handoffs/<actualuuid>.md

oracles.bad_handoff: excluded invalid-utf8 only derived path; no old rows in documents/metadata/links/source_state; current Gannet fact remains; source bytes unchanged
oracles.bad_dynamic: typed BrainError with offending path; no traceback/raw codec exception; refresh incomplete with no positive delivery/publication; native lookup/creation strictly refuses
oracles.bad_parse: same incomplete contract as UTF8; known invalid native record never verified absent
oracles.late_subtree: PermissionError before first native yield; no index commit or false A admission; complete old SQL snapshot stays
oracles.late_stat_error: same strict incomplete for lstat/scandir iteration failure
oracles.positive_absence: genuinely missing root/identifier produces typed not-found; legitimate native creation works
oracles.not_found_text: path-bearing BrainError containing not found never authorizes create/_existing/rebind/autoprovision or promotion retirement
oracles.handoff_type_path: untrusted type=handoff in dynamic record does not hide identity
oracles.working_warning: actual task_record path only after fresh native proof; warnings print once; old memory layers empty

expected.capsule: other memory served; no working state

unicode_metadata.claims: Local native metadata encoding validation only; no independent derived-index failure claimed.
